name: Wang Kuan
bio: Wang Kuan (王觀; Wang Guan; 1035–1100) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 生查子 (Sheng cha zi)
poems.author: Wang Kuan
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
关山魂梦长，塞雁音书少。
两鬓可怜青，一夜相思老。
归傍碧纱窗，说与人人道。
真个别离难，不似相逢好。
